summary.key_theme: Palo Alto Networks 受益於 AI 驅動的資安防禦技術升級，市場對其持續性服務模式與競爭優勢持正面看法。

bullish.title: Palo Alto Networks Stocks Surges 2.4% as AI Defense Becomes Continuous Service
bullish.reason: 將 AI 防禦轉型為持續性服務模式，顯著提升了營收的可預測性與客戶黏著度，直接推動股價上漲 2.4 %。

bullish.title: BlackBerry Advances 5% on Continued QNX Momentum; Palo Alto Networks Gains 4%, CrowdStrike Edges Up 2%
bullish.reason: PANW 在市場整體資安板塊走強的背景下表現優於同業 CrowdStrike，顯示資金對其技術領先地位的認可。

bullish.title: All In On Cybersecurity: The Choice Between Palo Alto Networks or Crowdstrike Not Difficult
bullish.reason: 分析師觀點傾向於 PANW 在資安領域的長期投資價值高於競爭對手，強化了市場對其基本面的信心。

neutral.title: Is AI-Driven Edge Security Integration With Nvidia’s Stack Altering The Investment Case For Palo Alto Networks (PANW)?
neutral.reason: 探討與 Nvidia 技術堆疊整合對投資案例的影響，目前處於評估階段，尚未對股價產生明確的利多或利空訊號。
